sources.supports: OpenAI's current pricing page lists GPT-5.5 Pro's base and long-context rates with a 272K threshold.
OpenAI identifies the model snapshot associated with its initial release period.

sources.quote:
### Apr 24

Feature · Model: gpt-5.5 · Model: gpt-5.5-pro · API: v1/responses · API: v1/chat/completions · API: v1/batch

Released [GPT-5.5](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5), a new frontier model for complex professional work, to the Chat Completions and Responses API, and released [GPT-5.5 Pro](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5-pro) for Responses API requests for tougher problems that benefit from more compute.
sources.supports: OpenAI's changelog dates the GPT-5.5 Pro launch to Apr 24, 2026.

notes: OpenAI's current documentation shows a 272K threshold, while its launch changelog dates GPT-5.5 Pro's release to Apr 24, 2026. The sources available here do not establish what threshold OpenAI officially published between launch and the models.dev correction, so they cannot distinguish an actual price change from a models.dev fix. Internet Archive CDX returned HTTP 503, preventing retrieval of dated snapshots.
